metadata.title: {% assign title = scope.page.title | normalize_whitespace | regex_extract: '^(.+?)\\s*-\\s*(?:歌单|排行榜)\\s*-\\s*网易云音乐$', 1 %}{% if title != empty %}{{ title }}{% else %}歌单 {{ scope.params.id }}{% endif %}
